author: Travis Crabb
title: Photos: Iowa Hawkeyes exhibition match against the Maryville Saints - The Daily Iowan
text:
The No. 10 Iowa Hawkeyes defeated the Maryville Saints, 124-67, during an exhibition basketball game at Carver-Hawkeye Arena on Thursday evening.
Iowa’s new guard Dani Carnegie was a main part of the Hawkeye offense, leading both teams with 30 points to give Iowa the win. Even in this blowout, Iowa head coach Jan Jensen made sure to keep her team disciplined on defense. After letting up several three-pointers in a row in the second half, she called a timeout.
“Why are we giving up back-to-back threes?” Jensen asked her team. After talking to them through the whole timeout, they only let up seven points for the rest of the game.
Iowa is back at Carver-Hawkeye Arena to host the Towson Tigers for their first regular-season game on Nov. 2 at 7 p.m. CST.
